prompts.k0_scare: Horror film still, vertical. Out of pitch-black darkness, a pale gaunt ghostly face emerges very close to the lens: hollow sunken dark eye sockets with tiny glowing pale pupils, cracked grey skin, thin long black wet hair framing it, mouth slightly open in a silent scream. Lit only from below by a cold faint light, everything else is black. Grainy 35mm horror cinematography, shallow focus, terrifying but no blood, no gore.
prompts.k1_mansion: Horror film still, vertical. A towering decaying Victorian mansion on a hill at night, a huge pale full moon directly behind its tallest tower, bare twisted trees clawing at the sky, thick ground fog rolling over a dead lawn, a rusted wrought-iron gate half open in the foreground at the bottom, one single upstairs window lit dim amber with the dark silhouette of a thin figure standing in it, every other window black. Cold blue-grey moonlight, cinematic, photoreal, 35mm, deep shadows, no people outside, no text.
prompts.k2_door: Horror film still, vertical. The front porch of a decaying Victorian mansion at night: worn stone steps rising to a tall black double door with a tarnished brass knocker, two old iron lanterns on either side burning low and orange, thick fog creeping over the steps, dead vines and cobwebs on the columns, a crow on the railing. The door is open a crack and a sliver of dim candlelight leaks out. Photoreal, 35mm, cold moonlight against warm lantern glow, deep shadows, no people, no text.
prompts.k3_hall: Horror film still, vertical. The grand entrance hall of an abandoned Victorian mansion at night, a wide sweeping staircase curving up into darkness, dozens of melted candles burning on the steps and in tall candelabras, a dusty crystal chandelier hanging from above, cold moonbeams slanting through a tall arched window full of dust, heavy cobwebs, a faded red carpet on the stairs. At the top landing, barely visible in the shadows, a tall dark figure stands watching. Photoreal, 24mm, cinematic, warm candlelight versus cold moonlight, deep blacks, no text.
prompts.k4_corridor: Horror film still, vertical, one-point perspective. A long narrow corridor in a Victorian mansion at night, both walls covered floor to ceiling in old gilded-frame portraits of pale stern people whose eyes seem to look at the camera, candles burning in wall sconces and dripping wax, thick cobwebs, a worn patterned runner rug leading to a single door at the far end that stands half open onto total darkness. Warm flickering candlelight, deep shadows, dust in the air, photoreal, 35mm, no text.
prompts.k5_figure: Horror film still, vertical. The same kind of dark candlelit Victorian corridor lined with old portraits, and from a half-open door at the end a very tall thin pale figure is stepping out into the hallway: elongated limbs, impossibly long bony fingers reaching forward, a featureless gaunt face in shadow, ragged dark cloth hanging from its frame. The candles near it gutter. Photoreal horror cinematography, 35mm, deep shadows, terrifying, no blood, no gore, no text.

prompts.c0_scare: The pale ghostly face violently lunges straight toward the camera out of the darkness, very fast, its mouth stretching open wider in a scream, wet hair whipping, ending with the face filling the whole frame, a violent handheld shake. Horror film jump scare. The background stays pitch black. No blood, no gore, no text.
prompts.c1_mansion: Slow ominous push in toward the haunted mansion. Thick fog rolls over the dead lawn, bare branches sway in the wind, a flash of lightning lights the clouds once behind the tower, the single lit upstairs window flickers and the thin silhouette in it slowly steps back out of view, the open gate creaks a little. Keep the house shape, the moon and the composition stable. No morphing, no new objects, no text.
prompts.c2_door: Slow push in up the stone steps toward the tall black doors. The doors slowly creak open by themselves, revealing deeper flickering candlelight and darkness inside. The lantern flames flicker, fog rolls down the steps toward the camera, the crow on the railing turns its head to look at the camera. Keep the architecture stable. No people, no morphing, no text.
prompts.c3_hall: Slow smooth glide forward toward the foot of the grand staircase. Hundreds of candle flames flicker, the crystal chandelier sways slightly and tinkles, dust drifts slowly through the cold moonbeam, and the dark figure on the top landing slowly withdraws backward into the shadows and disappears. Keep the staircase and architecture stable. No morphing, no new objects, no text.
prompts.c4_corridor: Slow steady dolly forward down the corridor. The candle flames flicker and gutter, and the eyes of the painted portraits on both walls slowly turn to follow the camera as it passes. The half-open door at the far end slowly swings open a little wider onto blackness. Keep the corridor, frames and paintings stable apart from the eyes. No morphing, no new objects, no text.
prompts.c5_figure: The very tall thin pale figure steps fully out of the doorway into the corridor, then suddenly rushes straight toward the camera with jerky unnatural speed, its long bony fingers reaching for the lens, the candles it passes blow out one after another, ending with darkness filling the frame. Horror film scare, handheld shake. No blood, no gore, no text.
